description_en: Sets the maximum available bandwidth for an elastic IP address (EIP) that is added to an Internet Shared Bandwidth instance
description_zh: 调用ModifyCommonBandwidthPackageIpBandwidth接口为已经加入到共享带宽的EIP设置最大可用带宽值
name: ModifyCommonBandwidthPackageIpBandwidth

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the Internet Shared Bandwidth instance. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh: 共享带宽所属的地域ID。您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the Internet Shared Bandwidth
parameters.name: bandwidth_package_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the EIP that is added to the Internet Shared Bandwidth instance. This parameter applies only to EIPs. For IPv6 addresses, use IpInstanceId
parameters.help_zh: 已经加入到共享带宽的 EIP 的实例 ID。仅适用于 EIP；IPv6 地址请使用 IpInstanceId
parameters.name: eip_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the public IP address instance for which you want to set the maximum available bandwidth in the Internet Shared Bandwidth instance. This parameter and EipId are mutually exclusive. We recommend that you use this parameter for new workloads. If IpType is set to VpcIpv6, specify the ID of the IPv6 address
parameters.help_zh: 要设置共享带宽内最大可用带宽的公网 IP 实例 ID，与 `EipId` 二选一，建议新业务使用此字段。IpType 为 VpcIpv6 时传 IPv6 实例 ID
parameters.name: ip_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The resource type of the public IP address for which you want to set the maximum available bandwidth in the Internet Shared Bandwidth instance. Valid values:
EIP: the public IP address of an EIP.
VpcIpv6: the IPv6 address of a VPC.

If this parameter is not specified, the default value is EIP
parameters.help_zh:
要设置共享带宽内最大可用带宽的公网 IP 的资源类型。取值：
EIP：EIP 产品的公网 IP 地址。
VpcIpv6：VPC 的 IPv6 地址。

未指定时按 EIP 处理
parameters.name: ip_type

parameters.help_en: The maximum bandwidth that can be allocated in the Internet Shared Bandwidth instance. Unit: Mbit/s
parameters.help_zh: 在共享带宽内最大可分配的带宽值。单位：Mbps
parameters.name: bandwidth
